title: The Agentic Economy Takes Center Stage at Sui Basecamp 2026 in Singapore
summary: Singapore, Singapore, 27th August 2026, Chainwire
content:
Skip to content

Singapore, Singapore, 27th August 2026, Chainwire

Singapore, Singapore, August 27th, 2026, Chainwire

Two days at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore, on October 7-8, alongside TOKEN2049, with product reveals, leading voices in AI, and a live attempt at a sustained TPS record.

The Sui community worldwide is invited to Sui Basecamp 2026, held October 7-8 at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore alongside TOKEN2049. This year’s program centers on the agentic economy: instant settlement, autonomous payments, private transactions, stable digital dollars, and post-quantum security.

Sui Basecamp is the Sui ecosystem’s flagship annual gathering, bringing together the people building, investing in, and shaping what comes next on Sui. Over two days, founders, builders, developers, investors, traders, and industry leaders come together for product reveals, technical deep dives, hands-on demos, and direct conversations with the people pushing the technology forward. Top-tier speakers from inside and outside the Sui ecosystem will provide a peek into what’s coming next and offer a direct look at the infrastructure carrying finance onchain.

This year, one conversation will loom especially large: the rise of the agentic economy. The next $5 trillion in transactions won’t be human. Agentic finance needs rails that settle instantly, prove ownership and authorization, and keep transaction details private by default. 

Hear From the Builders of the Agentic Future

What happens when you put a macro legend, the architects of Sui, an AI pioneer, a gaming visionary, and builders of the autonomous economy on the same stage? That’s just the beginning of the Sui Basecamp lineup:

  • Raoul Pal, Co-Founder and CEO of Real Vision, has spent his career mapping where capital moves next, and was early to the shift from traditional macro into digital assets.
  • Adeniyi Abiodun, Co-Founder and Chief Product Officer of Mysten Labs, is part of the team that came out of Meta’s Diem project that went on to build Sui and the infrastructure for the autonomous economy.
  • Kostas Chalkias, Co-Founder and Chief Cryptographer at Mysten Labs, works on the cryptographic foundations autonomous systems depend on, including Sui’s push toward post-quantum security. He also will lead the Main Stage speed test.
  • Hilmar Veigar Petursson, CEO of Fenris Creations and formerly CEO of CCP Games, spent more than two decades running one of software’s longest-lived player-driven economies. He is bringing that experience onchain through EVE Frontier.
  • Alex Mourfarek, Director of Inception at Google DeepMind, works at the intersection of frontier AI research and entrepreneurship, helping turn breakthrough ideas into ambitious new AI ventures.
  • Jen Zhu Scott, Co-Founder and CEO of Power Dynamics, is building the cooling and energy storage infrastructure that AI relies on to scale.
  • Brian Quintenez, Director of Sui Holdings Group and a former commissioner of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission, is an expert on public policy and regulatory frameworks in crypto.
  • Richard Socher, Co-Founder and CEO of Recursive and You.com, builds at the front edge of AI research and the evolution of intelligent software.

Explore the full Sui Basecamp 2026 speaker roster here, with more names to be added over the coming weeks.

A Live Record Attempt on the Main Stage

On October 7, live on the Main Stage, Mysten Labs Co-Founder and Chief Cryptographer Kostas Chalkias will push Sui to its absolute limit in a public, real-time speed test. The target is to break Sui’s standing record of 6,086,766 transactions per second (TPS), recorded earlier this year on July 4th. 

Participate live from Marina Bay Sands or anywhere in the world: submit your TPS prediction to compete for first (10,000 SUI), second (5,000 SUI), and third-place (1,000 SUI) rewards. Details will be announced by @SuiNetwork on X.

High throughput shows how much room the network has under real load, which is exactly what an economy of agents will demand. The test is built to mirror those conditions. AI agents and users will transact across games, payments, and chat using programmable tunnels, producing the velocity expected when software transacts continuously and at machine speed.

To ensure total transparency, web3 security leader CertiK will serve as the independent auditor for the attempt. Every transaction will be logged in a cryptographic transcript for post-test verification and formal reconfirmation, providing proof that can be mathematically audited rather than simply observed.

Following the attempt, attendees are invited to join a celebration on-site. 

Get Hands-On at Sui Basecamp

Sui Basecamp isn’t just about what happens on stage. In the AI Builder Lab, get hands-on with the latest AI tools, join sessions led by teams building at the intersection of AI and Sui, and learn how to build AI-powered applications and agents yourself. Then head to the Trading Arena to watch your favorite traders go head-to-head live on Hudi where you can watch their moves in real time. Whether you’re here to build,or try something new, Sui Basecamp is designed for active participation.

Sui Basecamp Brings Builders and Capital Together

Sui Basecamp is designed around what happens when the people building on Sui occupy the same space. This year, the people building the agentic financial stack across protocols, wallets, payments, data infrastructure, AI systems, institutions, and applications are converging on the same set of problems. Sui Basecamp puts them in one room for two days.

If you’re building at the intersection of technology and finance, investing in the machine to machine future, or trying to understand where the next generation of economic activity is headed, this is the room to be in.

“Economic activity is shifting from people clicking checkout buttons to agents transacting on their behalf, continuously and at machine speed,” said Adeniyi Abiodun, Co-Founder and Chief Product Officer of Mysten Labs, the original contributor to Sui. “That only works when intent, authorization, and settlement can each be proven onchain. Sui Basecamp is the one place where every layer of that stack is in the same room, so you leave understanding the whole picture instead of one piece of it.”

Sui Basecamp 2026 is sponsored by AlphaFi, EVE Frontier, and Walrus at the Diamond level, ONE Championship at Platinum, Slush at Gold, RedotPay at Silver, and Scallop, Anyflo, Merkle Science, and Sentio at Bronze.

How to Register

A standard pass covers both days, including all presentations, programming, workshops, expo areas, and official opening and evening events. 

Lock in the discounted rate at luma.com/SuiBasecamp2026 and join us in Singapore on October 7-8. Build with us.

About Sui

Sui, where money moves as freely as messages, is a next-generation Layer 1 blockchain built for scalable finance and global payments. Founded by the core team behind Meta’s stablecoin initiative and powered by an object-centric model, Sui makes assets, permissions, and user data programmable and ownable. Sui’s primitives offer builders everything they need to create high-performance payments and financial applications, including instant agentic payments. Learn more at sui.io. Learn more about Sui Basecamp at sui.io/basecamp.

title: Prediction Markets Follow Prop Firms Into the US Introducing Broker Model
summary:
Prospect Markets, said today (Thursday) that its US brokerage arm became a registered introducing broker. Prospect Brokerage USA joined the National Futures Association (NFA) and registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).
A separate affiliate joined a CFTC-regulated exchange th...
content:
2026-08-27T13:46:00.000+02:00

Thursday, 27/08/2026 | 11:46 GMT by Damian Chmiel

  • Prospect Markets, a sports prediction-market company, split its business into retail and institutional units.
  • Crypto.com companies will provide the exchange, clearing and customer-account services behind both routes.

Prospect Markets, said today (Thursday) that its US brokerage arm became a registered introducing broker. Prospect Brokerage USA joined the National Futures Association (NFA) and registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).

A separate affiliate joined a CFTC-regulated exchange three days earlier. The two approvals split Prospect's US rollout between retail distribution and direct exchange access, extending a shift toward third-party prediction-market infrastructure.

Prospect Brokerage USA LLC will introduce individual customers. Prospect Trading USA LLC supports Prospect Markets' institutional business.

Both routes rely on Crypto.com entities for exchange, clearing and customer-account infrastructure. Crypto.com spun out its standalone OG prediction-market platform this year.

One Brand, Two US Subsidiaries

Prospect Brokerage registered as a guaranteed introducing broker under an agreement with Foris DAX FCM LLC, which does business as OG Broker. The Crypto.com affiliate will carry the accounts that Prospect introduces.

Prospect will find and onboard customers but will not hold their funds. US prop firms have begun adopting a similar model.

Under NFA rules, the guarantor futures commission merchant (FCM) is liable for the guaranteed IB's acts and omissions. It must also carry every customer account introduced by the IB.

Prospect said the registration allows its brokerage unit to introduce US retail customers to Crypto.com Derivatives North America (CDNA). The exchange offers fully collateralized event contracts, primarily tied to sports.

"Our focus turns to commercialization," founder and Chief Executive Officer Johnny Chen said.

CFTC registration is not an endorsement of Prospect Markets or its products. Prospect included that caveat in its announcement.

A Separate Company Handles Institutional Trading

Prospect Trading USA, the institutional subsidiary, became a CDNA exchange member on Monday. Prospect said the membership gives the unit direct access to CDNA.

CDNA is a trading name of North American Derivatives Exchange, which the CFTC regulates as a designated contract market.

Other trading platforms are also connecting institutional clients to the venue. Trading Technologies connected its platform to OG.com this month.

Prospect first outlined the retail route in a non-binding July agreement with OG Broker. At that time, the companies still needed final agreements and regulatory approvals.

Crypto.com Uses the Model With Other Consumer Brands

Prospect is not the first customer-facing company to use Crypto.com's FCM as guarantor for a prediction-market IB.

High Roller Technologies, a listed online gaming operator, signed its Crypto.com agreement in April. Its ROLR US subsidiary became an NFA member and guaranteed IB in June, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

High Roller plans to distribute CDNA contracts through its ROLR platform. Its June filing said Crypto.com's FCM would process transactions, carry customer accounts and hold client assets.

In both arrangements, the consumer brand supplies the interface and customer relationship. Crypto.com's regulated companies provide exchange access and account infrastructure.

Prop Firms Use IBs to Move Traders Into Live Accounts

Futures prop firms use IB affiliates for a different product funnel. Topstep and Tradeify connect traders in simulated programs with personal futures accounts.

Topstep Brokerage uses Plus500 for clearing and technology.

Tradeify launched Slay Markets in May with NinjaTrader Clearing as its FCM.

Tradeify's founders later told FinanceMagnates.com that the prop business becomes a funnel for live accounts. That lets Tradeify keep the customer relationship when a trader moves from simulation to a personal brokerage account.

Prospect is not a prop firm and does not sell simulated trading challenges. The common element is the separation between customer acquisition and account custody.

The US product is not live. Prospect's July announcement targeted a start before the third quarter ends on September 30, but Thursday's release gave no date.

title: Worldcoin (WLD) Price Prediction: Bullish SuperTrend Flip Puts $0.42-$0.52 Resistance in Focus
summary: Worldcoin (WLD) has entered a stronger short-term recovery phase after a prolonged decline, with technical indicators beginning to turn positive across multiple timeframes.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: WLD

Worldcoin (WLD) has entered a stronger short-term recovery phase after a prolonged decline, with technical indicators beginning to turn positive across multiple timeframes.

WLD is trading around $0.40 after gaining more than 12% over the past week, while a bullish SuperTrend flip on both the daily and weekly charts has drawn attention to the possibility of a broader stabilization.

The recovery follows a steep multi-year decline from above $11. According to crypto trader @0xSupremo_, WLD has rebounded roughly 79% from its May 2026 low near $0.23. The trader’s analysis highlights higher lows on the daily chart and SuperTrend support near $0.33, although the weekly setup remains in an early stabilization phase rather than a confirmed long-term reversal.

WLD’s SuperTrend has flipped bullish on both the daily and weekly charts, signaling a potential shift from its prolonged multi-year downtrend toward a broader recovery. Source: @0xSupremo_ via X

The immediate technical challenge is concentrated around $0.42-$0.52. This area represents a significant resistance band that WLD would need to overcome before the recent recovery could develop into a more established uptrend.

WLD Price Momentum Strengthens

Short-term momentum has improved considerably as WLD moved back above $0.40. A 30-minute trend-following scan shared by Olivier Langlois identified WLD at $0.4116, roughly 4.57% above its 24-hour volume-weighted average price (VWAP).

WLD shows strengthening bullish momentum across multiple timeframes, with rising RSI, positive MACD crossovers, and improving DMI readings supporting the trend. Source: Olivier Langlois via X

The same scan recorded an RSI of 82 and an ADX reading of 32, accompanied by solid trading volume on Kraken. The readings point to strong near-term momentum, although the RSI level also indicates that the market was entering overbought territory on the 30-minute timeframe.

The trader described the setup as “TRENDY HEAT” while highlighting bullish price action across the 15-minute, 30-minute, one-hour, and four-hour charts. Positive MACD crossovers and improving directional movement readings added to the short-term momentum signal.

That strength does not necessarily mean WLD must continue rising without interruption. A high intraday RSI can also leave the market vulnerable to a consolidation or pullback before another attempt at resistance.

SuperTrend Signals Early Recovery

The SuperTrend indicator is providing one of the more notable technical developments for WLD. @0xSupremo_ identified bullish flips on both the daily and weekly charts, following an extended period in which the token remained under significant selling pressure.

The bullish SuperTrend flip signals early stabilization, but WLD remains within a broader downtrend and needs sustained higher highs to confirm a meaningful trend reversal. Source: @0xSupremo_ via X

On the daily chart, the formation of higher lows and SuperTrend support near $0.33 suggest that buyers have gained greater control of the recent price structure. However, the weekly signal is better viewed as an early improvement than definitive evidence of a long-term trend reversal.

A sustained series of higher highs would provide stronger confirmation. Until that occurs, the current move can still be classified as a recovery within a much larger historical downtrend.

The analyst also pointed to recent developments involving a Grayscale ETF filing and reduced token unlocks as factors that could improve the market backdrop for WLD. These developments may influence investor sentiment, but price confirmation remains important when assessing whether the technical recovery can persist.

Moving Averages Create Key Support

WLD’s position relative to its major moving averages is another important part of the current Worldcoin price prediction setup.

Recent technical analysis placed the 20-day, 50-day, and 200-day moving averages in a relatively narrow range around $0.36-$0.37. With WLD trading near $0.40, the token is currently above this cluster.

That positioning is constructive because the three averages provide a broader reference for short-, medium-, and long-term price trends. Maintaining the area as support would strengthen the recovery structure, while a sustained move below it would weaken the current bullish case.

The first nearby support levels are around $0.39 and $0.38. A decline through those levels would bring $0.36-$0.37 into focus. This moving-average zone is arguably more important than the immediate supports because it represents a convergence of several technical trend measures.

RSI Shows Buying Momentum

The Relative Strength Index (RSI) also favors buyers, although its interpretation depends heavily on the timeframe.

Recent daily readings have been around 60-63. Bitget’s technical data showed RSI(14) at 62.94, while another recent analysis placed the indicator at 60.4. Both readings are above the neutral 50 threshold but below the conventional 70 level associated with overbought conditions.

This gives WLD some room for additional upside momentum without the daily RSI itself signaling an extreme extension.

The picture is different on shorter timeframes. @cryptolevier’s 30-minute scan showed RSI at 82, indicating considerably stronger short-term momentum and a market that was already overbought on that timeframe.

The contrast between the daily and intraday RSI readings is important. It suggests that the broader recovery has strengthened without the daily market yet reaching the same level of technical extension seen on the shorter chart.

MACD Confirms Improving Momentum

The Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) indicator is another supportive component of the current setup.

Recent technical readings show the MACD line above its signal line alongside a positive histogram. One reading placed the MACD line at 0.012281, the signal line at 0.002637 and the histogram at 0.009644. Bitget’s more recent data showed MACD(12,26) at 0.01528 with a Buy signal.

The positive separation between the MACD and signal lines indicates that upward momentum has increased. This provides additional confirmation for the price recovery rather than relying solely on WLD’s move above $0.40.

However, MACD remains a lagging momentum indicator. It can confirm an established move, but it cannot by itself establish whether a long-term trend has definitively reversed.

WLD Faces $0.40-$0.42 Resistance

The $0.40-$0.41 area is now the first major test for WLD. The token has been trading around this region, making a sustained close above the zone more significant than a temporary intraday breakout.

A decisive move above $0.41 could shift attention toward $0.42. The latter level is particularly important because it aligns with the 0.382 Fibonacci retracement of the approximately $0.23-$0.72 swing.

Breaking and holding above $0.42 would therefore provide a clearer technical signal that the recovery is extending beyond its initial phase.

Above $0.42, the next levels identified by recent technical analysis are $0.44 and $0.46. A move through $0.46 would represent another structural improvement and could put the $0.47 Fibonacci level into focus.

$0.47 Fibonacci Level Becomes Important

The $0.47 area carries additional significance because it corresponds closely with the 0.500 Fibonacci retracement of the recent $0.23-$0.72 swing.

WLD currently sits between the 0.236 retracement near $0.34 and the 0.382 level around $0.42. A move above $0.42 would therefore take the token through the first major Fibonacci resistance in the recovery structure.

Reaching $0.47 would require WLD to clear several intermediate barriers, including $0.44 and $0.46. For that reason, the level should be viewed as a medium-term technical reference rather than an immediate price objective.

The broader resistance area highlighted by @0xSupremo_ extends toward $0.52. A move into that region would require considerably stronger follow-through than the current rebound has demonstrated so far.

Buyers Defend $0.35-$0.36 Zone

The downside structure remains equally important for assessing the Worldcoin price prediction.

Crypto trader Karim Beker recently identified $0.3590 as a key level on the four-hour Binance chart. A long lower wick around that area was interpreted as evidence of buying interest after sellers pushed price lower.

$WLD is consolidating near $0.3988, with $0.3590 showing buyer defense and $0.3400 serving as key historical support. Source: Karim Beker via X

The trader also highlighted $0.3400 as historical support that has remained relevant since the recent uptrend began. The chart shows WLD advancing from below $0.33 before entering a period of consolidation around $0.40.

These levels provide useful reference points if the current rally loses momentum. Holding $0.35-$0.36 would preserve much of the recent recovery structure, while a sustained breakdown below $0.34 would materially weaken it.

Bollinger Bands Signal Elevated Volatility

Bollinger Bands reinforce the view that WLD has entered a higher-momentum phase.

Recent readings place the upper band around $0.41, the middle band near $0.35, and the lower band around $0.28. With WLD trading close to $0.40, price is positioned near the upper portion of the volatility range.

Trading near the upper band is consistent with strong buying pressure, but it can also precede consolidation when price moves too far above its recent average. A sustained expansion above the upper band would indicate continued volatility expansion, while rejection around $0.41 could send WLD back toward lower support levels.

TradingView Keeps Longer-Term Rating Neutral

Despite the improvement in short-term technical conditions, TradingView’s broader ratings remain more cautious.

TradingView’s selected timeframe currently gives WLD/USD a Buy rating. However, its one-week and one-month technical ratings remain Neutral. The difference highlights the distinction between improving short-term momentum and a confirmed long-term trend reversal.

That distinction is particularly relevant after a multi-year decline. A bullish signal on a shorter timeframe does not automatically invalidate the larger bearish structure.

For WLD to establish a more convincing long-term reversal, price would need to sustain higher highs and higher lows while remaining above major moving-average support and clearing successive resistance levels.

Worldcoin Price Prediction: Key Levels to Watch

The current technical structure gives traders several clearly defined levels to monitor.

On the upside, $0.41-$0.42 is the first major breakout area. A sustained move above it could bring $0.44, $0.46, and $0.47 into focus. The broader resistance zone identified by recent analysis extends toward $0.52.

On the downside, $0.39-$0.38 represents immediate support. Below that, the $0.36-$0.37 moving-average cluster is the key technical area. The $0.35 trendline region and $0.34 historical support provide additional downside references.

As of August 27, WLD’s technical picture is therefore improving, but the evidence remains stronger for a short-term bullish recovery than for a fully established long-term reversal. The positive MACD, RSI above 50, rising trend strength, and price above the major moving-average cluster all favor buyers. At the same time, neutral weekly and monthly TradingView ratings show that confirmation is still lacking on broader timeframes.

A sustained break above $0.41-$0.42 would strengthen the recovery case and place $0.44-$0.47 on the technical map, while a move toward $0.52 would require further resistance to be cleared. Conversely, losing $0.36-$0.37 would weaken the structure and put $0.35 and $0.34 back into focus.

Technical indicators should be treated as market-analysis tools rather than standalone forecasts. TradingView also notes that its technical ratings are not intended to serve as the sole basis for investment decisions and should be considered alongside price action, market conditions, and other relevant information.
